title.zh: 乘法表中第 k 小的数
title.en: Kth Smallest Number in Multiplication Table

desc.zh: 从逐行数格子推导答案二分，保留重复值并证明区间边界。
desc.en: Count cells row by row, then derive a binary search that keeps duplicates and preserves answer bounds.

complexity: O(min(m,n) log(mn)) time; O(1) auxiliary space

concepts.name: Multiplication-table threshold count
concepts.description: Count cells at most x using clipped row prefixes.

concepts.name: First sufficient value invariant
concepts.description: Keep C(lo−1)<k≤C(hi) while shrinking an inclusive value interval.
